notes: I replaced the piecewise Gaussian (which had too-light tails and mismatched the shoulder values) with a stretched-exponential `A*exp(-(|x|/s)^p)` per side, fitting p≈1.44 left / 1.56 right and s≈1.28 / 1.82 from E2/E4, plus a small negative baseline (~-0.002) to match the tails seen in E1/E3/E5.
